title: loxogramme yakushimae
intro: Loxogramme yakushimae, commonly known as Yakushima tree fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Loxogramme yakushimae include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may help to prevent various diseases.
